g.text: The process harnesses of P9: N2 and the replay across blocks
N2: one deploy set in four runs
with a role variable, one child at a time
over an in-memory store, at the v6 limits
read the records of n2-a and n2-b
the four runs give equal records
30, 28 and 28 deploys at the v6 limits
open the store at the pre-state
decode the evidence, check the journal,
bind the trace to the event log
post-state root of the deploy before it
play the three blocks again over
an in-memory store, in the parent process
of each family and of the agent
A record holds the pre-state and post-state roots, the outputs, the event log,
the evidence bytes, the phlo and the host work of play. A child prints no test
output to the parent: the parent keeps the standard output of each child.
stored state and the record files
write to a store or to a record file
